hooks.command: docker run --rm -i --network none -e CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" -v "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:ro" -v "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/specs:$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/specs" -v "$HOME/.claude/projects:$HOME/.claude/projects:ro" oven/bun:1.4.3-debian bun "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/progress-reminder.ts"

statusLine.command: P="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; docker run --rm -i --network none -v "$P/.claude:/statusline:ro" -v "$P/specs:$P/specs:ro" -v "$HOME/.claude/projects:$HOME/.claude/projects:ro" -w "$P" oven/bun:1.4.3-debian bun /statusline/statusline.ts 2>/dev/null || echo 'status line unavailable: is Docker running?'
